# a&o Hostels & Hotels

> > Budget-friendly hostel and hotel chain offering affordable accommodations across 30+ European cities with loyalty rewards and best price guarantee.

a&o operates 40+ properties across major European cities including Berlin, Amsterdam, Vienna, Prague, and Barcelona. The chain caters to backpackers, families, business travelers, and groups with flexible booking options and a&o Club membership benefits.

## Key Topics

- Budget accommodation
- European hostels
- a&o Club membership
- Hostel booking
- Best price guarantee
- Multi-city locations
- Backpacker travel
- Family-friendly hostels
- Business travel
- Loyalty discounts
- Central locations
- Group bookings
- Major cities: Berlin, Amsterdam, Vienna, Prague, Hamburg, Munich, Dresden, Frankfurt, Budapest, Edinburgh

## Essential Information

- [a&o Hostels & Hotels - central, affordable and comfortable](http://aohostels.com/): Homepage for a&o Hostels chain offering budget accommodation across Europe
- [Alle a&o Standorte - Hier gibt es überall ein a&o Hostel](https://www.aohostels.com/at/alle-standorte): Directory of all a&o Hostels locations across Europe
- [a&o App](https://www.aohostels.com/at/ao-app): a&o mobile app for booking hostels and a&o Club membership benefits
- [Günstig übernachten im a&o Backpacker-Hostel](https://www.aohostels.com/at/backpacker): Backpacker hostels across 40+ locations in 30 European cities
